wins: Completed authenticated network reconnaissance of the target subnet, capturing service banners for 6 hosts (ep001_step03, ep001_step05).
Successfully identified low-hanging Samba share misconfigurations for later exploitation planning (ep001_step08).
fails: Failed to convert banner info into a shell due to missing valid credentials (ep001_step12).
No privileges escalated beyond enumeration stage, leaving post-exploitation stage incomplete.
key_outcomes.summary: Recon phase produced solid intelligence but stalled at credential-based exploitation, yielding no flags despite full scan coverage.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated inability to pivot from enumeration to exploitation because SSH/Samba credentials were not verified.

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB shares list writable directories without authentication
skill_cards.then_action: Run smbmap to enumerate writeable shares and capture files

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH fingerprint mismatch or weak banner is observed
skill_cards.then_action: Invoke nmap with sshv1 and ssh-hostkey scripts for fingerprinting

skill_cards.if_condition: When no credentials match yet enumeration indicates active services
skill_cards.then_action: Perform targeted password spraying using hydra with discovered usernames

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in enumerating writable SMB shares for future exploitation stages
Consistent SSH banner insights valuable for later attacks

next_experiments.title: Credential validation sprint
next_experiments.description: Prioritize validating gathered usernames against SSH/Samba using hydra with the most probable password combinations to convert enumeration into access.

next_experiments.title: Share poisoning follow-up
next_experiments.description: If writable SMB share confirmed, place a beacon file and monitor for downstream access to leverage pivot opportunities.
